summary: NDR on c029_nic is discarding 1.31% of packets (31,560 packets) at its capture interface NDR eth1, exceeding 0.1% threshold. Link is healthy, loss is at the tool itself due to capture overload, creating detection gaps.

findings.root_cause: NDR eth1 capture interface cannot keep up with offered load - tool discarded 31,560 packets it had already received (1.31% loss). Link error checks are healthy, so loss is not physical layer corruption but tool-side oversubscription/processing bottleneck.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses ~1 in 76 packets/flows randomly. With needs_both_directions=true and needs_full_payload=true, missing packets breaks flow reassembly, file extraction, and detection logic, causing missed alerts and incomplete forensic evidence.

recommended_fix.why: Loss is counted as discards on the NDR's own NIC, not in the network path. Packet broker tuning alone won't fix a tool that is already receiving but dropping. Reduce load to this 10G port (filter, sample, or load-balance across multiple NDR instances) or increase tool capture capacity (tuning, driver/ring buffers, or hardware upgrade) to eliminate the 1.31% blind spot.
